In AdaptiveLogSoftmaxWithLoss, head output is 5000 + shortlist offset, but the model's head layer has 5001 rows (n_classes + 1 to include the tail class). The custom head op should produce 5001 columns, while the tail op should produce 5000 columns, making the combined n_classes = 10001. The reference output shape is [2048,1,10000] because the last head column (index 5000) is not included in the final concatenation; instead, the tail logits are inserted at that position. The combine launcher incorrectly assumes head_cols=5000, resulting in output n_classes=10000 and missing one head column, or output shape [2048,1,10001] if head_cols=5001 is used but the tail is appended after 5001 columns, whereas the reference behavior likely drops the extra head column and uses the tail logits for the high frequency classes.
